name: privacyfill-ai-mvp
description: Privacy-preserving Chrome form-filling agent for the SIH MVP.

scripts.test: npm run build:extension --silent && node --test tests/unit/*.test.js tests/integration/*.test.js
scripts.test:acceptance: npm run build:extension --silent && node --test tests/integration/release-flow.test.js tests/integration/plan-route.test.js tests/unit/confirmation-overlay.test.js tests/unit/profile-validation.test.js
scripts.test:privacy: node --test tests/unit/contracts.test.js tests/unit/leak-checker.test.js tests/unit/accessible-name.test.js tests/unit/label-sanitizer.test.js tests/unit/form-adapters.test.js tests/unit/dom-region-mapper.test.js tests/unit/screen-capture.test.js tests/unit/ephemeral-capture-store.test.js tests/unit/visual-coverage-checker.test.js tests/unit/visual-redactor.test.js tests/unit/ephemeral-redaction-store.test.js tests/unit/visual-boundary.test.js tests/unit/popup-view-model.test.js tests/unit/planner-client.test.js tests/unit/action-validator.test.js tests/unit/audit-log.test.js tests/unit/confirmation-overlay.test.js tests/integration/privacy-boundary.test.js tests/integration/external-privacy-boundary.test.js tests/integration/framework-fill-flow.test.js tests/integration/plan-route.test.js tests/integration/local-fill-flow.test.js
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run test:privacy && npm run verify:static && npm run verify:secrets && npm run verify:docs
